visual_identity.silhouette: tall soft-sided rectangular pillow bag, wider through the filled middle, with a gently uneven sealed top and a flat filled base
visual_identity.closure: factory heat-sealed plastic top and bottom seams
visual_identity.grip_geometry: soft flexible bag gripped only at its outer edges or supported from below
visual_identity.front_label: large red panel with gold border, ROYAL UMBRELLA arched across the top, THAI JASMINE RICE below it, a gold tiered-umbrella illustration, and a green circular seal
visual_identity.back_label: not supplied; keep the supplied front facing the camera and do not invent a back panel
